summary: NIO Inc. filed a Form 6-K with Exhibit 99.1 providing its August 2026 monthly delivery update. The company delivered 35,836 vehicles in August 2026, up 14.5% year-over-year, with cumulative deliveries of 1,260,485 through August 31, 2026. The filing also highlights the inauguration of its 4,000th battery swap station and the NIO ES8 reaching 140,000 cumulative deliveries. This is a routine operational press release by a foreign private issuer, not a special-situation corporate event. No M&A, tender, restructuring, or strategic review is involved.
